subject: demonstrator-statements-final

metrics.nhs_productivity: CSOAI demonstrator: 22-axis measurement of NHS AI systems (radiology, pathology, GP triage, etc.) across 14 model axes + 8 deterministic-fact axes. Outputs: signed audit trail, Bitcoin-anchored proof of when measured, corrections ledger for any later revisions. Directly supports NHS 10 Year Health Plan + 5 UK AI principles.
metrics.compute_efficiency: CSOAI demonstrator: signed inference efficiency receipts at pod scale. Each inference produces a signed card with correctness, latency, FLOPs/watt, tokens/sec/$. Aggregates to per-model + per-vendor efficiency scores. ARIA Scaling Inference Lab can use as standard. Pod fpowppss5ngtkw at $0.22/hr provides baseline.
metrics.defence_mission: CSOAI demonstrator: DEFONEOS compartment (15 MCPs + 6 Labs + 33-agent BFT council) for secure AI integration across MoD systems. Hard stops doctrine (NO kinetic-targeting, NO personal-surveillance, NO compartment mixing). Audit-grade, signed, neutral, UK-sovereign, AUKUS-compatible.
metrics.agent_security: CSOAI demonstrator: three-layer architecture for AI agent security. CSOAI measures (22-axis), AGISafe decides (ALLOW/RESTRICT/REQUIRE-HUMAN/STOP), ASISecurity enforces (sandboxing, permissions, revocation). 12 MCPs already deployed. NCSC AI threats + OWASP LLM Top 10 coverage.

honest_sentence: Final demonstrator statements (one per competition): NHS (22-axis measurement of NHS AI), Compute (signed inference efficiency receipts), Defence (DEFONEOS compartment), Agent Security (three-layer architecture). Ready for application Section 3.
